weekLabel: Maine edition · Thu Jul 16 - Sun Jul 19 · refreshed Thu Jul 16 · drive times on Maine picks are from Kennebunkport. Tap a source to confirm before you go.

events.name: World Cup Final — watch it from Kennebunkport
events.meta: Free to watch · The Final from MetLife at 3pm. In Maine: Federal Jack's, 8 Western Ave, Kennebunk — waterfront brewpub 5 min away, call 207-967-4322 to confirm they'll show it — or Portland's Old Port pubs (Rí Rá, 72 Commercial St). Back home instead? Somerville's free watch party runs 2:30-7pm at Union Square Plaza — registration required, weather-contingent. source

events.name: Yarmouth Clam Festival
events.meta: Free entry · Main St, Yarmouth ME · Fried clams, 3 music stages, 130+ craft booths, carnival rides. Parade Fri evening, fireworks Sat night (verify times on the schedule). Southern Maine's biggest street festival and only ~50 min up 95 from you. Go early, park at the edge of the village. source

events.when: Thu-Sun, 7pm (Sat Jul 18 is the ASL night)
events.name: Cinderella at Prescott Park
events.meta: Suggested gate donation · 105 Marcy St, Portsmouth NH · The outdoor waterfront musical, blanket seating under the stars — made for KK and Isabella, and only 30 min down the coast from Kennebunkport. Runs Thu-Sun through Aug 9; confirm tonight's show on the site (verify). source

events.name: Hello, Dolly! — Ogunquit Playhouse closing weekend
events.meta: Ticketed · 10 Main St, Ogunquit ME · Broadway-caliber musical in its final days — the kind of show KK lives for, 20 min from the house. Box office 207-646-5511 for remaining seats. source

events.name: Free live music at Perkins Cove
events.meta: Free · Rotary Park, Perkins Cove, Ogunquit ME · Free music on the water in the lobster-shack cove — easy pre- or post-dinner stop for all five. Act TBA (verify). source

events.name: Portland Farmers' Market + Old Port morning
events.meta: Free to browse · Deering Oaks Park, Portland ME · Saturday market, then wander the Old Port for lobster rolls and chowder. Easy morning before an afternoon beach. source

events.name: ArtBeat 2026: REVolution — Davis Square
events.meta: Free · Somerville · 40th year, ~100 craft and food vendors, two music stages, dance and street performance. Street fest noon-7, music at Seven Hills Park to 9. Rain date Sun Jul 19. For anyone back home this weekend. source

events.name: Salisbury Beach Concert + Fireworks
events.meta: Free · Oceanfront stage · Something Else plays 7:30-10, fireworks over the water 10:15. Also ~45 min from Kennebunkport — a natural stop if you drive home Saturday night. Arrive before 7 for parking. source

events.name: Revolution vs Toronto FC
events.meta: Ticketed, from ~$30 · Gillette Stadium · MLS restarts right after the Final; Revs host Toronto Wed and Atlanta United Sat. The affordable live-soccer follow-up for Dave & Alex. source

events.name: Boston Landmarks Orchestra — Hatch Shell opener
events.meta: Free · Esplanade · Season opener "Best of Boston": Bernstein's West Side Story dances plus a gospel ensemble and Brazilian drumming. Free orchestra Wednesdays on the river through Aug 12. Blankets. source

events.name: Lynch Park Summer Concert
events.meta: Free · Beverly · Free concert in the shell at the family's favorite oceanfront park. Act for Jul 26 not yet confirmed — check the Rec Dept page before going (verify). source

events.name: Yankee Homecoming — Newburyport
events.meta: Mostly free · Nine days of waterfront concerts, craft fair, road race and fireworks in a favorite walkable town. Kickoff party + brewfest Sat Jul 25, 5-9pm at Cashman Park (21+ $35 adv, under-21 $5); Lions road race Tue Jul 28. source

events.name: Maine Lobster Festival — Rockland
events.meta: Ticketed grounds · 79th year: lobster every way, the Great Crate Race, the parade, live music on the bay. Wed noon-10pm, Thu-Sat 8:30am-11:30pm, Sun to 6:30pm. Full-day-plus trip. source
